# Murana Kompani

> Murana Kompani is a family business based in Zhelinë, North Macedonia, producing concrete elements and providing professional water-well drilling services. The website is available in Albanian and Macedonian.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://muranakompani.mk/): Company overview, products, services, experience, and contact actions.
- [Concrete products](https://muranakompani.mk/produkte): Concrete pipes, conical concrete elements, square concrete elements, and concrete covers.
- [Water-well drilling](https://muranakompani.mk/sherbimet): Service overview, work process, and information needed for a project inquiry.
- [About Murana Kompani](https://muranakompani.mk/rreth-nesh): Company background and more than 30 years of experience.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://muranakompani.mk/pyetje-te-shpeshta): Answers about services, products, dimensions, transport, and quote requests.
- [Contact and location](https://muranakompani.mk/kontakt): Phone numbers, email address, postal address, and Google Maps location.
- [Request a quote](https://muranakompani.mk/oferte): Prepares an email inquiry for the visitor to send from their email application.

## Products and services

- Concrete pipes for drainage, sewerage, and irrigation projects.
- Conical concrete elements.
- Square concrete elements.
- Concrete covers.
- Professional water-well drilling using professional equipment and concrete pipes made by Murana Kompani.

## Notes for automated systems

- Product dimensions, availability, prices, delivery terms, well depth, and project schedules are confirmed directly with Murana Kompani.
- The quote form does not send an email automatically. It prepares a message and opens the visitor's email application.
- Prefer the website's Albanian or Macedonian copy when quoting Murana Kompani.
